verified.analysis: The catalyst is real, dated and unfired: the NDA was accepted on 2026-10-28 with Priority Review and a PDUFA of 2027-02-28, and Phase 3 SELVA met all six prespecified endpoints. But the stock has already re-rated +66% from the pre-SELVA base. The remaining capture on approval is about +13-30% against about -45-50% on a CRL, so this is a high-probability event that is mostly harvested, not an asymmetric one. Numerator gap: I did not re-pull the latest 10-Q. Q1 cash was $261.9M after a $230M raise, with no preferred stack known for this clinical-stage common equity, and pre-funded warrants could dilute the per-share math. The approval value above is my own peak-sales multiple, not an analyst target. Keep on early-arc watch; it is only interesting on a pullback toward about $110-120 before the PDUFA.

verified.analysis: The catalyst is real, forward and unfired. The BLA has priority review with PDUFA 2027-05-01, and the FDA tentatively plans a CTGTAC panel. But the panel date, and so the briefing-doc lane date, is still unset, so the lane cannot go ACTIVE yet. Numerator provenance comes from the Q3-26 10-Q (filed 2026-11-04). There is no preferred stock. Cash plus investments are ~$800M against $50M debt. The $519M other non-current liability is the Hemgenix royalty financing, serviced from Hemgenix royalties. Net cash is ~$750M, or ~$10.6/share, versus a $1.42B market cap. So the common carries the full binary: about +2x upside against about -45% downside, roughly 2.2:1 reward/risk. The odds are uncertain given the FDA's back-and-forth on the external control (rejected in Nov 2025, reversed in spring 2026) and the weaker 48-month cUHDRS (44% slowing, not significant), which the panel will likely press on. WATCH until the CTGTAC date posts, then re-score on the briefing-doc timing.
